items.title: Fundbox CEO Prashant Fuloria at Money2020 USA Powering Small Business Economy
items.summary:
In this interview from Money20/20 USA, Prashant Fuloria, CEO of Fundbox, discusses embedded finance, small business lending, capital access, and the evolving role of fintech in supporting entrepreneurs.

JD Durkin spoke with Fuloria about embedded lending, automation, fintech partnerships, cash flow management, and opportunities to improve financial access for small businesses.

A significant portion of the discussion focuses on how embedded financial services are transforming the way business owners access capital.

The interview also explores Fundbox's approach to integrating lending solutions directly into platforms that businesses already use daily.

Another major theme is the importance of cash flow and working capital management for small business success.
The conversation further examines partnerships with QuickBooks (NASDAQ: INTU), Stripe, SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ: SOFI), and other financial and software providers.

The interview also highlights how embedded lending can reduce friction and streamline access to financing at critical moments within business workflows.

Another key topic is technology-driven underwriting and the use of automation to evaluate and serve business customers more efficiently.

The discussion explores how financial institutions and fintech providers can better address the needs of underserved small businesses.

Additionally, Fuloria discusses trust, transparency, and responsible lending practices within modern digital financial services.

The conversation further examines the operational challenges traditional lenders face when serving smaller businesses seeking modest amounts of capital.

Another focus is the scalability of fintech platforms and their ability to expand access to financial products through automation.

The interview also highlights how embedded finance is becoming increasingly integrated into software, payments, and business management platforms.

Looking ahead, Fuloria expects continued growth across embedded lending, digital finance, fintech partnerships, small business services, and technology-enabled capital solutions.

Throughout the discussion, Fuloria shares perspectives on fintech, lending, entrepreneurship, working capital, embedded finance, automation, digital banking, payments, financial technology, and small business growth.

items.title: Upstart Is the Real Loser in Intuit’s Credit Karma Guidance Cut
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIntuit cut its fiscal 2027 revenue growth outlook to 8%-9% from 9%-10%, and the whole cut came from Credit Karma, whose growth forecast fell to 3%-7% from 11%-13%. Credit Karma traffic produced 52% of Upstart’s loans in 2020, and Upstart still relies on it for many of its borrowers.
